title: Prototype template shows every state panel when a project sets display on the state sections (#58)
symptom: In Leif's Raven session every prototype state (loading, empty, error, ready) showed at once; tests/package.rs the_prototype_template_keeps_hidden_state_panels_hidden fails on main f41e7ab4
trigger: A project rule that sets display on the template's state sections (for example .surface section { display: grid }) overrides the browser's [hidden] { display: none }
expected: Only the selected state panel is visible whatever display rules a project adds
actual: templates/prototype/styles.css has no [hidden] rule, so every hidden state panel renders

notes.text: Also TC-cli-prototype-styles-0-4-0-known-outdated: the fix changes styles.css, so installs of the 0.1.0 to 0.4.0 bytes must read known-outdated; this run fails first because those bytes are still current
